findings.ownership_disposition: AppTelemetryBinding owns one LatestValueMailbox consumer task. The mailbox retains at most one in-flight frame and one replaceable buffered frame, and detach invalidates its generation and stops it.

findings.ownership_disposition: All gauge renderers borrow the process-wide MetalGaugeResources device, command queue, and pixel-format pipeline. Views draw on demand and explicitly dismantle surface-local buffers and delegates.

findings.ownership_disposition: Each renderer owns one capacity-growing MetalVertexBuffer. Telemetry updates copy into existing shared storage; allocation occurs only for initial capacity or bounded high-water growth, and dismantle releases the surface-local buffer.

findings.ownership_disposition: RigDashboardView no longer owns a TimelineView animation clock. Telemetry publication is the display clock, each renderer requires dirty state, and disabling auto-refresh produces zero Metal draws while source telemetry continues.

findings.ownership_disposition: AppTelemetryBinding stores and cancels its mailbox consumer and manual refresh task. detach removes the listener, stops the mailbox, invalidates the generation, cancels refresh work, and releases the app reference.

findings.ownership_disposition: The standalone dashboard command owns its SIGINT and SIGTERM sources until its blocking run ends. A defer now clears both handlers, cancels both sources, and stops the server.

findings.ownership_disposition: managerStartBackground owns Process only through launch. After Process.run duplicates launch descriptors, durable lifetime transfers to the manager child identified by its PID file and managed by the stop command.

findings.ownership_disposition: The background-launch scope owns the parent manager-log FileHandle. A defer closes that handle after launch verification; the child retains only its duplicated descriptor.

findings.ownership_disposition: merged is function-local to one checkpoint and both input loops stop at ContextContinuityService.maximumAgentSnapshots (128); the second-checkpoint test verifies the merged packet remains at 128.

findings.ownership_disposition: ContextContinuityService creates, stores, and retains no Swift concurrency Task. The audit match was the markdown phrase Current Task; the neutral Current Work heading removes the scanner ambiguity.

findings.ownership_disposition: suffix is stack-local to one canonicalURL call, released on return, and bounded by the finite number of components between the target path and its deepest existing ancestor.
